# 18 — Handheld Equipment, Suits & Drones

First-person (1P) viewmodels are skeletal meshes on the shared weapon skeleton (`SK_EQP_<Name>_1P`); third-person (3P) world models (`SM_EQP_<Name>_3P`) are used on characters, as loot and on weapon racks. Suits are skeletal meshes on the character skeleton (`SK_SUIT_<Name>`). Texel density: 1P 2,048 px/m, 3P 1,024 px/m.

**1P rules:** the grip socket sits at the palm center; the ADS sight socket is on the optical axis; animated parts are bones, not separate meshes; the muzzle socket's +X points down the barrel. **3P rules:** single mesh, max 2 materials, pivot at the grip.
